failure_modes.evidence: Nilotinib targets BCR-ABL, which is primarily relevant in hematologic malignancies like CML. Using it in melanoma represents a population mismatch - melanoma typically lacks BCR-ABL alterations that would make this mechanism relevant.
Sample size of only 20 patients is very small for detecting meaningful efficacy signals, though the effect sizes observed were so low that underpowering alone doesn't explain the failure.
